messages.author: bf430f85cbca7f07
messages.subject: Item Information high dimensional model
parts:
Hello,
for my bachelor thesis I have to compare the item information curves of BigFive questionnaire data. I have done a Confirmatory Multidimensional IRT, but I cannot display the item information curves. I then get the following error:

itemplot (ipip5d, item = 2, type = "info").
Error: Can not plot high dimensional models

Can anyone help me?
Thanks a lot
Wiebke

Here is my command for model estimation:
irtipip <- IPIP_Wave13_Original.r[, 1:50]
modipip <- mirt.model('
extraversion = 1, 6, 11, 16, 21, 26, 31, 36, 41, 46
verträglichkeit = 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47
gewissenhaftigkeit = 3,8, 13, 18, 23, 28, 33, 38, 43, 48
neurotizismus = 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, 29, 34, 39, 44, 49
intellekt = 5,10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50
COV = extraversion*verträglichkeit*gewissenhaftigkeit*neurotizismus*intellekt
')
ipip5d <- mirt (irtipip, model = modipip, itemtype = 'graded',
               method = 'MHRM', SE.type = 'MHRM', verbose = FALSE)

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Item Information high dimensional model
parts:
The information curves are hyper-dimensional, so computing them is not easy or particularly useful to do.

Phil
